annotations.title: Get leads who replied with interest

description: List the people the Performance page counts as Interested (get_performance_summary engagement.interested: same definition, same campaigns, same window), newest first, with the reply text. Readings come from language-model reply classifiers, a deterministic hot-lead rule, older keyword rows, or the operator's own Interested mark; a STOP, wrong number, no or opt-out never counts. The response names each row's source and includes the reply so you can judge for yourself. Read-only.

days.description: How far back to look, in days (1-365). Default 30.
